map.DLI 过高会烧苗吗？: Will an excessive DLI scorch seedlings?
map.→ 打开光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算工具: -> Open the light accumulation (daily light integral DLI) calculator tool
map.一般不会因 DLI 过高伤苗，但强光伴随高温会引发光抑制。重点是『时长×强度』组: A high DLI alone rarely damages seedlings, but strong light combined with high temperature causes photoinhibition. What matters is the combination of duration and intensity, and in summer shading is often more important than adding light.
map.不能直接换算，lux 含人眼权重，PPFD 是植物有效光合光子通量密度（µmol: They cannot be converted directly: lux includes a human eye weighting while PPFD is the photosynthetically active photon flux density for plants (µmol/m2/s). PPFD must be measured with a spectrometer or a dedicated quantum sensor.
map.光照累积量（每日光积分DLI）计算 使用指南: How to use the light accumulation (daily light integral DLI) calculator
map.对比自然光照是否达标，决定补光时长与强度。: Check whether natural daylight meets the target, to decide the supplementary lighting duration and intensity.
map.按日光照强度与时长积分计算每日光积分 DLI，评估设施作物光环境是否充足，适用于: Integrate the daylight intensity and duration to compute the daily light integral DLI and assess whether the light environment for protected crops is sufficient, for greenhouse supplementary lighting design, seedling photoperiod control and yield optimisation.
map.用于温室补光设计：多数果蔬苗期 DLI 需求 12~20 mol/m²/d。: Used for greenhouse supplementary lighting design: most fruit and vegetable seedlings need 12-20 mol/m2/d of DLI.
map.：实测平均 PPFD = 350 µmol/m²/s，冬季日照有效 10 小时。: : the measured average PPFD = 350 µmol/m²/s with 10 effective daylight hours in winter gives DLI = 350 × 10 × 3600 / 1e6 = 12.6 mol/m²/d. That is below the tomato requirement of 20, so supplementary lighting must add about 7.4 mol.
